opportunities.name: Ambush hybrid poison
opportunities.objective: Use the five-second stealth-exit attack buff with E's inspected AD and AP terms.
opportunities.mechanic: E's initial on-hit and four-second poison include both AP and AD statFormula terms. Statikk supplies both stats, Nashor adds attack magic damage and Rageblade tests repeated initial on-hits. Passive grants a finite attack-speed burst after stealth and W maintains attack distance.
opportunities.requiredState: Stealth achieved before opening; one target kept in range during the five-second buff.
opportunities.failure: Detection or early peel loses the attack-speed window and poison refresh wastes duration.
opportunities.test: Separate initial E damage from poison ticks under normal and phantom hits, then vary AD and AP independently.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Repeated attacks do not prove independent stacking four-second poison damage streams.

opportunities.name: Trap into blind contact
opportunities.objective: Use a preplaced trap to start sustained combat before a protected attack trade.
opportunities.mechanic: R deals AP magic damage over four seconds and reveals enemies; Q blinds attacks and W's active keeps speed when hit. Liandry and Riftmaker test a burn-to-contact hand-off, while Cosmic responds to magic damage and Nashor rewards attacks during the blind window.
opportunities.requiredState: Trap actually triggers shortly before Q and attack access; finite traps and cooldowns recorded.
opportunities.failure: Sweeping or bypassing traps prevents ramp and spell damage still threatens through blind.
opportunities.test: Record combat ramp at trap activation and total attacks landed during Q blind versus a Q-only opening.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Blind blocks ordinary attacks, not all incoming abilities or item damage.

ruledOut.reason: R has finite charges/recharge and traps expire after five minutes.

unknowns: Poison refresh/phantom-hit rules, Statikk on-hit propagation and unresolved R charge recharge need live logs.

builds.name: Ambush hybrid poison
builds.summary: Use the five-second stealth-exit attack buff with E's inspected AD and AP terms.
builds.goal: Use the five-second stealth-exit attack buff with E's inspected AD and AP terms.
builds.hypothesis: E's initial on-hit and four-second poison include both AP and AD statFormula terms. Statikk supplies both stats, Nashor adds attack magic damage and Rageblade tests repeated initial on-hits. Passive grants a finite attack-speed burst after stealth and W maintains attack distance.
testPlan: Required state: Stealth achieved before opening; one target kept in range during the five-second buff.
Separate initial E damage from poison ticks under normal and phantom hits, then vary AD and AP independently.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Detection or early peel loses the attack-speed window and poison refresh wastes duration.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Repeated attacks do not prove independent stacking four-second poison damage streams.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Statikk Shiv, Nashor's Tooth, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Terminus, Zhonya's Hourglass, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
